spans: We are writing to you about a change in your school schedule. Your term started on September 1, 1996.
Because of this change, we may have paid you too much money.
On November 5, 1996, you went from 12 credit hours to 6 credit hours.
On December 1, 1996, we lowered your payment to $202.00 a month.
We will send you another letter about this.
That letter will tell you if you owe us money.
Please write to us and tell us why you lowered your credit hours.
We usually need proof, too.
If you don't have proof, tell us why you don't have it.
If you don't have proof, tell us why you don't have it.
The paper called "Changes in Your Enrollment" has more details. It is in the envelope with this letter.
Please send us your statement and any proof within 30 days.
*If we accept your reason:*
- We will not lower your payments back to the start of the term.
If you already owe us money
you will still have to pay it back
But you will not owe more than that.
*If we do not accept your reason:*
- We will lower your payments starting September 1, 1996. That is the day your term began.
- This means you will owe us money. You will have to pay it back.
*If you do not answer in 30 days:*
- We will lower your payments starting September 1, 1996. That is the day your term began.
- This means you will owe us money. You will have to pay it back.
- You can still send us information after the 30 days. We will look at anything you send us within one year of the date on this letter.
- If you have a good reason you could not answer in that time, we may give you more time.
- If you have a good reason you could not answer in that time, we may give you more time.
You have certain rights before we make our final decision.
The paper called "Basic Rights" explains them. It is in the envelope with this letter.
VA Form 21-4138
